en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Muhammad Bin Al Husayn, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Hashim, from Abu Khadeeja, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Al-Ajwa, it is the mother of the dates which Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic Sent down to Adamas, from the Paradise’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn Yahya One Hundred and Twenty Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Abd al- Rahman ibn abu Hashim from abu Khadijah who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
al-‘Ajxvah is the mother of dates which Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, sent for Adam from paradise.’”
